scripts.infra: cd docker && docker compose -f docker-compose.infra.yml up -d
scripts.infra:down: cd docker && docker compose -f docker-compose.infra.yml down
scripts.dev: npm run dev:down && cd docker && docker compose watch
scripts.up: npm run infra && cd docker && docker compose up -d
scripts.down: npm run dev:down && npm run infra:down
scripts.clean: cd docker && docker compose -f docker-compose.infra.yml -f docker-compose.yml down -v
